description: A yellow tabletop is in front of a white fabric backdrop, with a light blue cleaning cloth on the surface and a small spray bottle nearby. The left hand presses the cloth against the tabletop and wipes it back and forth across the center area, while the right hand holds the spray bottle near the right side, shifting it slightly closer and then away without spraying, keeping the cloth as the left-hand object and the bottle as the right-hand object.
